title: Money watch
summary: Reads the Ledger for a charge made twice and a payment that repeats, and asks you once about each. Charged twice stops asking about a payee whose last three answers were Both real, and Looks like it repeats switches itself off after three No's in a row.
changes: Charged twice and Looks like it repeats keep a short number that is part of a shop's name. Studio 54 Cafe was read as Studio, so two shops that start alike were one payee and a question could name the wrong shop. A number of one or two digits now stays in the name, and a longer one still ends it. A card number written in groups, as in CARD 1234 5678 NETFLIX, is cut whole, so the payee is Netflix.
author: BrainDog
